sunfields.name: The Sunfields
sunfields.text: A wide, harshly sunlit frontier of hard earth, glassed patches, exposed metal ribs, shifting routes and settlements that behave like temporary holds rather than permanent towns.

last-drop.name: The Last Drop Saloon
last-drop.text: Dusty frontier saloon with splintered boards, a dark rear wall, patched bar, hard white daylight at the doors and a back lot opening onto the settlement edge.

cinder-basin.name: Cinder Basin
cinder-basin.text: White alkali dust, fractured basalt, chalk ravines, sinkholes, buried rusted machinery and hard reflected noon glare.

mirage-club.name: The Mirage Club
mirage-club.text: Subterranean frontier club and solar-flare bunker: oxidized copper, dark wood, old acoustic panels, service corridors and a heavy brass vault door.

relay-station.name: Deep-range relay station
relay-station.text: Rusted observation deck, scratched ballistic glass, narrow service corridors, generator bay, scrubbers, exposed pipes and hard sunrise over the Sunfields.
